title: Concat's vkCmdCopyBuffer regions sit between compute->compute barriers that order neither the copies' reads nor their writes
expected_finding: mul_scalar writes tensor_lhs / tensor_rhs and its trailing barrier has destination COMPUTE_SHADER / SHADER_STORAGE_READ, so the vkCmdCopyBuffer reads of those buffers (TRANSFER_READ) are not ordered after the writes; the barrier after the copies has source COMPUTE_SHADER / SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE, so the copies' TRANSFER_WRITEs to tensor_concat are not made available to rms_norm, which reads it (read-after-write in both places)
